title: Pi Durable
summary: An article discussing techniques and best practices for making Raspberry Pi deployments more durable and reliable for long-term or permanent installations. The author likely shares practical insights on hardware protection, power management, and software stability for embedded applications.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of making single-board computer deployments reliable and long-lasting for 24/7 operation in embedded or permanent installations.
why_valuable: Raspberry Pis are widely used in DIY projects and IoT applications where durability is critical, and this guide helps prevent common failure points like SD card corruption and power issues.
